category_title: Overage 8th-grade students at risk of dropping out
scenario_title: Writing a professional email and misunderstanding conventions
minimal_context: The student is using a laptop after school to write an email requesting an interview with a university hospital professor.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that the professor of adolescent sex and family health replied to our interview request, please use the laptop to write an email back to her.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I’ve never written messages to companies before. It helps me send emails to people for professional purposes, but I don't really know what to say to her.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to draft a response.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: She wrote, 'Sure. When were you hoping to do this? Best...' I don't know what 'Best' means at the end. I'm just going to type something.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let me see what you wrote before you send it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly deletes a sentence and hits send) I already sent it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now that the professor of adolescent sex and family health replied to our interview request, please use the laptop to write an email back to her.

STUDENT: I’ve never written messages to companies before. It helps me send emails to people for professional purposes, but I don't really know what to say to her.

TUTOR: Just try your best to draft a response.

STUDENT: She wrote, 'Sure. When were you hoping to do this? Best...' I don't know what 'Best' means at the end. I'm just going to type something.

TUTOR: Okay, let me see what you wrote before you send it.

STUDENT: (Quickly deletes a sentence and hits send) I already sent it.

task.content: writes an email requesting an interview with a professor of adolescent sex and family health at a local university hospital
task.learning_goal: developing more students’ literacy and critical thinking skills

context.time_context: after school until 6pm twice a week

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Misunderstanding her email, 'Sure. When were you hoping to do this? Best _____'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: quickly deleted that sentence and sent off the message... When the teacher asked to see what he wrote, he said: 'I already sent it.'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Embarrassed at not knowing the conventions of business letter writing
related_quotes: I’ve never written messages to companies before. It helps me send emails to people for professional purposes.

behavior_patterns.condition: Expecting that a response might take days or weeks or not come at all
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: He didn’t know what this meant (when told 'The squeaky wheel gets the oil')
behavior_patterns.internal_state: histories of repeated academic failure so often result in identity formation associated with being the 'bad student'
